title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz
seo_title: Mahj Mondays: American Mahjong Open Play in Springfield
description: Mahj Mondays is an open play night for American Mahjong, presented by The Gallery at the Gillioz with Blooming Bams. It suits players of all skill levels who already know American Mahjong (NMJL rules); bring your own 2026 NMJL card, and tile sets are provided. It runs Monday, November 16, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM at The Gallery at the Gillioz, 325 Park Central E., Springfield, MO, and admission is free.
